items.english: Though the days at a spa are long, noon had come at last. Having finished the two or three newspapers that had just arrived, Tatsuya had changed into the inn yukata to go to the bath and had stepped out into the broad corridor of the main house, when coming from the opposite way toward the foot of the stairs, passing him by, was one wiping with a steaming wet towel a neck smooth-drawn as jade. It was the maiden. That is she, Tatsuya marked at once. As he had fancied, her figure was beautiful beyond measure. With no adorning, a hundred native graces took a deeper lustre from the colour after bathing, and the stray hairs touching her snow-warm cheeks were bewitching beyond telling. A single dimple faintly breaking, eyes full of feeling stirring they knew not how, a gentle bearing not to be passed over, and ah, Tatsuya stood a while unable to move.
notes: Kept the long lingering inventory as one gathering sentence to preserve the lush erotic gaze; 玉を延べたる首筋 is a jeweled smoothness of the nape, rendered as smooth-drawn as jade rather than explained.

items.english: Just then, towel in hand likewise, slowly coming down the stairs was that Hotei man he had seen a while before. The maiden, just starting up, looked back at him. "Oh Father, in again? Shameless, are you not," she laughed with a guiltless laugh. The sweetness of that smiling face was beyond words.
notes: Kept Hotei per bible for 布袋のその人; 幕なしねえ is girlish teasing at another bath, rendered as Shameless rather than literal curtain.

items.english: "Father and daughter, first beauties of the land, Tokyo people," Tatsuya repeated in his breast as he went on to the bath. Coming after was master Hotei. Opening the right and left sliding doors of a bath newly fitted up at the upper end, the two went in together. At once was heard Tatsuya's voice, speaking to him without reserve.
notes: 国色 rendered as first beauties of the land to keep period height; 布袋殿 kept as master Hotei to hold the echo with p13.

data.say: Drafted p12-p14 keeping the lush bath-corridor gaze and Hotei echo.
